SiteUrl.title: Elevate Site URL
SiteUrl.description: Your organisation's own Elevate address, e.g. 'https://elevate.your-org.org'. The connector calls '{SiteUrl}/api/reports' - Elevate is hosted per organisation, so there is no shared default.

ApiKey.title: Report API Key
ApiKey.description: An Elevate Report API key, issued by your Elevate administrator. One key covers every report; the connector sends it in the request body as 'api_key' and never logs it. The reports it can reach are the ones listed at '{SiteUrl}/api/reports'.
